crackerssalt, to tasteThaw the peas, juice the limes and cut the cucumbers into sticks.Blitz the avocado, peas, lime juice, mint and salt until smooth and very green.Spoon into a bowl and serve with the cucumber sticks and crackers.MainsEmerald City green risottoCreamy arborio risotto stirred through with pea and spinach pureeHow to make it300g arborio rice1.3 L chicken stock200g frozen peas100g baby spinach100g parmesan100g butterHeat the stock, grate the parmesan and blitz the peas and spinach with a splash of stock until smooth.Stir the rice in some of the butter, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time.Stir through the green puree, the rest of the butter and the parmesan until bright green.Shiz dining hall stuffed chickenThe dining hall at Shiz UniversityHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, roasted at 200°C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and rice.Mix 200g ricotta with 60g chopped baby spinach, 30g grated parmesan, lemon zest and pepper.Cut a pocket in 4 chicken breasts and fill with the mixture.Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200°C for 20 minutes.Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice.Melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon, 1 crushed garlic clove and chopped parsley.Slice the chicken and spoon over the lemon butter sauce, with rice on the side.SweetsPink and green cakeButter sponge layers, one tinted pink and one greenHow to make it250g butter, softened, for the cake250g caster sugar4 eggs250g self-raising flourpink and green food colouring, a few drops of each300g icing sugar150g butter, softened, for buttercream1 tsp vanilla extractHeat the oven to 175°C and grease and line two tins.Beat the butter for the cake with the caster sugar until pale, beat in the eggs, then fold in the flour.Split the batter in two and tint one half pink and one half green.Bake in separate tins.Cool completely.Beat the butter for the buttercream with the icing sugar and vanilla, then stack the cakes with it.Pink meringue kissesSmall pink meringues, crisp outside and light insideHow to make it3 egg whites170g caster sugarpink food colouring, a drop250g raspberriesHeat the oven to 100°C and line two trays.Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.Fold in a drop of pink colouring and pipe small kisses onto the trays.Bake for an hour, then turn off the oven and cool the meringues inside it.Serve with raspberries.DrinksOzdust Ballroom pink lemonadeLemon juice and sugar with cranberry juice for colour, over iceHow to make it6 lemons150g caster sugar1 L cold water100ml cranberry juice125g raspberries1 bag iceJuice the lemons and stir with the sugar until dissolved.Add the water and cranberry juice.Pour over ice in four glasses and float a few raspberries on top.
